rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) for Year 2026
rules.quote: The Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The 2026 AGA of 1.0% represents 65% of the increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025, which was 1.5% as posted by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
rules.summary: Berkeley allows eligible landlords to increase rent by 1.0% starting January 1, 2026, calculated as 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase.
rules.effective_date_evidence: which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026
rules.coverage_text: The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants' rents when their tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set pursuant to Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act
